<thought>After searching the template catalog, the most appropriate single‑step retrosynthetic transformation is a cycloaddition that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and a C‑C triple bond while forming a new C‑C bond and a C‑O bond (the ester). Applying template 550659 to the target molecule cleanly disconnects it into two readily available precursors: (1) methyl acetate (COC(=O)C) and (2) the alkyne‑aryl‑silyl fragment C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C#C/C2=CC=CC=C2. This satisfies the requirement of a single reaction step.

The required JSON route is:
{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 550659,

        }
